title: Metallic Re-Crafted Compat
description: This resourcepack adds compatibility between Farcr's Re-Crafted and the Metallic resourcepack.
body:
This is a version of my [Metallic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/metallic) resourcepack (available [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/metallic-(resource-pack))), the pack designed for use with my Metallic datapack/mod. This version uses the palette from Farcr's [Re-Crafted](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/farcrs-re-crafted) and texturing inspired by the pack.

It includes custom sword models which require the use of [Modefite](https://modrinth.com/mod/modefite-item-definition-backport) on versions below 1.21.4


If you would like to join the discord server dedicated to my projects, please message me on discord @gravitybreacher for an invite.
